transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. I'm here because... well, my body just feels completely drained. It's like even just walking from my car into the clinic today took everything I have. I work as a healthcare tech, and lately, even just sitting down and opening the EHR at work feels like it takes all my energy. I'm just so exhausted.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
Not really, no. I still like the same stuff I usually do. I haven't noticed losing interest in things or anything like that... I just feel too tired to actually do much of it right now.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless lately?

Yeah, I have. After all that energy I had just kind of... dropped, I started feeling really empty. Just hopeless most days, honestly. It feels like I've already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been... I'd say about nine months now. Yeah, this whole depressed, guilty, and just totally exhausted feeling has been going on for nine months. It basically started right after I crashed from that... that really high-energy period I had before.

Before this low-energy period started, when you mentioned you were in a high-energy period, did you experience times where your mood was unusually elevated, irritable, or you felt like you didn't need much sleep?

Yeah, definitely. Some days during that time, I just felt... amazing. Like I was completely unstoppable. But then it would flip, and I'd get really irritable. Like, if one of the nurses corrected my documentation or even just told me to slow down a bit, I would snap at them. I'd react like they were insulting me right to my face.
How long did that high-energy period with elevated or irritable mood last before it switched into the low-energy, depressed state you’re describing?
It lasted... well, the whole crisis built up over about two months. It started right after my clinic changed my responsibilities at work.
During that high-energy period, did you have a distinct time where your mood was elevated or irritable for at least 4 or 5 days straight, even if it wasn't the full two months?

I'm not really sure about the exact number of days. It's hard to remember if it was four or five days straight without a break. That whole two months just kind of blended together into this... this big blur of feeling totally wired and then getting mad at people. I wasn't really keeping track of how many days in a row it happened, so I can't say for sure.
